candidates.change_summary: Remove the line that updates acc.balance with msg.value so Put no longer increases balance.
Remove the locked_ = false; statement at the end of the modifier so the reentrancy lock stays permanently locked after first use, blocking all subsequent calls.
Remove the acc.unlockTime check so funds can be collected regardless of unlock time.
Remove the acc.balance >= MinSum check so smaller balances can be collected.
Delete the acc.balance subtraction so collected funds are not deducted from the balance.
Remove the nonReentrant modifier's locked_ assignment so reentrancy becomes possible, allowing repeated Collect calls that drain more than balance.
